title: Power Automate: configure Flow checker rules and notifications for desktop flows in the admin portal
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the roadmap's launched notifications from Learn's documented rule configuration. The licensing, permissions and PowerShell call are supported; the admin-center path could be extended to name the Excluded Rules control. The cited Learn pages opened successfully despite the pre-check's rate-limit errors.

claims.claim: Learn does not document recipients, delivery channel or message contents for these desktop-flow checker notifications.
claims.quote: Searched: 'desktop flow Flow checker notifications recurrence recipients default licensing charges'. Read static-analysis and monitoring/alerts; runtime-notifications search excerpt concerns console runs, not checker violations. No checker notification recipients, channel or payload found.

claims.claim: Solution checker enforcement and exclusions are reached at Manage > Environments > environment > Edit Managed Environments > Solution checker enforcement.
claims.quote: select Manage. ... select Environments. Select a managed environment. ... select Edit Managed Environments ... under Solution checker enforcement. ... Use the Excluded Rules dropdown list to select the rules to exclude from enforcement.
claims.fix: For rule exclusions, extend controls[1].ui.path and its rendered table cell to 'Manage > Environments > environment > Edit Managed Environments > Solution checker enforcement > Excluded Rules'. The current path correctly reaches the section containing both controls.

claims.claim: SetManagedEnvironmentSolutionCheckerEnforcementLevel supports -EnvironmentId, -Level warn and -RuleExclusions with rule names.
